**sdd/issue-144-governance-v3/tasks**

**What**: Wrote the tasks checklist for issue-144-governance-v3 (100 checkbox tasks, strict-TDD RED/GREEN tagged, grouped into 11 chained-PR slices: PR1 L1+registry refactor, PR2a substrate detector core, PR2b governance-status extension, PR3 L3 memory-gate/decision-gate, PR4a L4 pure evaluator, PR4b L4 wrapper+CLI+hardening, PR5 L5 actor-check, PR6a L6 brain-writes-reviewed, PR6b CODEOWNERS+managed-paths, PR7 L2 release+postmerge workflows, PR8 ADR draft). Delivery strategy ask-on-risk, chain strategy feature-branch-chain (each PR targets previous PR branch; only tracker merges to main).
**Why**: sdd-tasks phase for change issue-144-governance-v3 — spec.md (20 REQs) and design.md (10 numbered decisions) both required a large multi-PR breakdown; single-PR was ruled out (well over 400-line budget across the full change).
**Where**: openspec/changes/issue-144-governance-v3/tasks.md (overwritten placeholder scaffold, kept frontmatter status:draft/issue:144). Real target paths referenced: brain/scripts/vcs/governance-checks.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/substrate.mjs (new), brain/scripts/brain-governance-status.mjs, brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs (new), brain/scripts/vcs/phase-order-check.mjs (new), brain/scripts/vcs/actor-check.mjs (new), brain/scripts/vcs/brain-writes-reviewed.mjs (new), .github/CODEOWNERS (new), brain/core/managed-paths.mjs, .github/workflows/governance.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml (new), .github/workflows/governance-postmerge.yml (new), openspec/changes/issue-144-governance-v3/brain-drafts/ (ADR draft, Tier-2 constraint — human moves to brain/project/decisions/ later).
**Learned**: Review Workload Forecast estimated no single slice exceeds 400 budget-relevant lines (tests + openspec/changes/** already excluded via brain.config.json governance.ignoreList); PR4a (L4 pure evaluator) is the largest at ~260 budget-relevant lines — flagged Medium risk with an explicit split-Rule-B fallback. Micro-decisions locked: L1 job name `local-checks`; registry split REQUIRED_JOBS/DETECTION_JOBS with GOVERNANCE_JOBS as union (design §7); L4 baseline/grandfather list hardcoded (installer-versionado/, vcs-adapter/, cli-i18n/); L4 status-ladder sourced from frontmatter only (dormant guard, Gap G2); bot/admin allowlist via brain.config.json governance.approvalActors + override:* label; rung-3 uses auto-revert PR (not tag-block, Gap G5); CODEOWNERS ships with placeholder @<human-reviewer-team>.
